content.value_statement: Hybrid cloud teams need secure links between data centers and cloud networks. This skill helps compare VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, and Interconnect patterns.
actual_capabilities: Compares VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, and GCP Cloud Interconnect options.
Outlines hub-and-spoke, multi-region, and multi-cloud hybrid network patterns.
Provides Terraform-style examples for AWS and Azure site-to-site VPN gateways.
Lists BGP routing, route propagation, and route filtering considerations.
Summarizes high availability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and cost optimization checks.
limitations: Does not replace provider documentation or certified network design review.
Does not validate live cloud accounts, routes, or tunnel status by itself.
Uses example IP ranges and resource names that must be changed before deployment.
Does not include full implementation guides for every provider feature.

use_cases.title: Cloud Migration Planning
use_cases.description: Plan staged connectivity from a data center to AWS, Azure, or GCP before moving workloads.

use_cases.title: Operational Troubleshooting
use_cases.description: Build a checklist for VPN tunnel status, latency, packet loss, and BGP session health.

use_cases.title: Governance Review
use_cases.description: Review hybrid designs for encryption, private endpoints, redundancy, monitoring, and cost controls.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Connection Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare VPN, dedicated private connectivity, and cloud interconnect choices for connecting one data center to one cloud. Include tradeoffs for cost, latency, reliability, and setup time.

prompt_templates.title: Design A Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a hub-and-spoke hybrid network for [provider] with one on-premises data center, production and staging networks, and BGP routing. List key decisions and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot A VPN
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a troubleshooting checklist for a hybrid VPN where tunnels are up but applications see intermittent latency. Cover routing, metrics, logs, and failover.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Multi-Cloud Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this multi-cloud hybrid architecture: [paste design]. Identify failure modes, routing risks, security gaps, monitoring needs, and cost optimization options.

output_examples.input: Need to connect a data center to AWS for a moderate bandwidth migration.
output: Recommended starting point: site-to-site VPN for speed and cost control.
Upgrade path: Direct Connect when traffic, latency, or compliance requirements justify it.
Validation checks: tunnel health, BGP routes, encryption settings, and flow logs.

output_examples.input: Review active-active connectivity across two regions.
output: Use redundant circuits from separate locations when possible.
Confirm BGP failover, route filtering, and equal-cost multipath behavior.
Monitor tunnel status, packet loss, latency, and session changes.

output_examples.output: Right-size bandwidth, consolidate traffic, use VPN for low-bandwidth workloads, and evaluate dedicated links for sustained high-volume transfers.

best_practices: Confirm bandwidth, latency, uptime, compliance, and provider constraints before choosing a connection type.
Use redundant links, dynamic routing, route filtering, and clear failover tests.
Enable flow logs, tunnel metrics, BGP monitoring, and regular security reviews.
anti_patterns: Copy example IP addresses, ASNs, or resource names into production without review.
Assume a single VPN tunnel is enough for critical workloads.
Skip route filtering, monitoring, or failover testing after deployment.

faq.question: Can this skill create production-ready network configs?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and examples. A qualified engineer must adapt and validate the final design.

faq.question: Which cloud providers does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers AWS, Azure, and GCP hybrid connectivity concepts.

faq.question: Does it favor VPN or private dedicated connections?
faq.answer: It compares both. VPN suits lower bandwidth or faster setup, while dedicated links suit predictable high-volume traffic.

faq.question: Can it troubleshoot live tunnels?
faq.answer: It can guide checks for metrics, routes, logs, and BGP state. It does not inspect live accounts by itself.

faq.question: Are the IP addresses ready to use?
faq.answer: No. They are examples and must be replaced with environment-specific addresses and CIDRs.

faq.question: Is it useful for security reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It highlights encryption, private endpoints, access controls, DDoS protection, monitoring, and redundancy.
